title: Luxury Short Term Rental (STR) Operations Manager - 3rd Shift
description:
Summary

We are seeking an experienced professional to enhance our luxury short-term rental operations. The ideal candidate will excel in guest experience and communication, manage cleaning operations effectively, and oversee property management tasks. Your expertise will ensure our guests receive top-notch service and maintain the highest standards of property upkeep. If you have a passion for hospitality and a track record of excellence in the luxury rental market, we want to hear from you!



See below for key responsibilities pertaining to this role: 



PROPERTY MANAGEMENT

Focus: Coordinating vendor work, maintenance tracking, issue resolution, inspections, and continuous improvements to the physical space.



• Maintenance & Repairs

Coordinating vendors, responding to maintenance issues, resolving repair needs promptly, and escalating costly or urgent issues to leadership for owner approval.



• Maintenance Portal Management

Ensuring all guest-, owner-, and TL-reported tasks are tracked and resolved in the maintenance platform (Breezeway).



• Vendor Sourcing & Vetting (Ops-Focused)

Vetting new repair, maintenance, landscaping, or specialty vendors based on factors such as services offered, pricing, coverage areas, availability, etc.



• Physical Property Inspections

Scheduling and completing quarterly walkthroughs for quality and condition tracking, as well as real-time issue resolution.



• Inventory Management & Audits (FF&E)

Overseeing key furniture, equipment, and tech items for tracking, replacement, and depreciation.



• Vendor Work Verification for Payment

Confirming completion and accuracy (and obtaining evidence) of work performed by vendors in a timely manner prior to finance initiating payment.



• Continuous Improvement of Physical Spaces

Identifying and implementing enhancements such as in-home signage, QR code instructions, or other physical/visual solutions to improve guest understanding, reduce issues, and enhance experience.



• Reporting & SOP Optimization

Creating reporting loops to identify inefficiencies, implementing recurring ops reviews, and developing and refining SOPs often to enhance operations.



GUEST EXPERIENCE

Focus: Ensuring high-touch, efficient guest support from pre-arrival through post-departure.



• Guest Communications Oversight

Managing and QA-ing guest communications (Rocket Station, HostBuddyAI, internal, etc), ensuring brand voice, scripts, escalations, accuracy and training.



• Phone Support Management

Overseeing coverage of all OpenPhone (Quo) calls/texts pertaining to guests and vendors, especially during emergencies.



• Pre-Arrival Experience

Ensuring smooth guest check-ins via codes, directions, amenities, and guidebooks, and verifying means of active communication with the guest.



• ECI & LCO Management

Managing all guest requests for early arrival or late departure, including confirming availability, communicating upsell pricing, updating internal systems, and coordinating with cleaning and maintenance teams to ensure readiness.



• In-Stay Issue Management

Overseeing resolution of guest-reported problems during their stay, including obtaining evidence and clarity on issue prior to resolution.



• Guest Concierge Services

Providing luxury touchpoints, gifts, or concierge assistance (e.g., birthdays, honeymoons, welcome surprises) on an as-needed basis.



• Review & Feedback Monitoring

Creating weekly reports summarizing public and private guest feedback with actionable takeaways to de-risk future reviews.



• Review Response Writing

Responding to all guest reviews in brand voice on Airbnb, VRBO, BDC, etc.; escalation and tracking of all non-5 star reviews.



• Guest Disputes & Escalations

Handling platform refunds, review disputes, and filing damage claims (Airbnb).



• Resolution Center Requests & Processing

Submitting and managing routine Airbnb Resolution Center actions, including security deposit requests (e.g., hot tub, pool heating) and processing guest-paid add-ons or reimbursements.



• SOP Documentation for Guest Communications

Creating and maintaining detailed reply templates, escalation paths, and guest FAQs.



• Maintain Accurate Guest-Facing Information

Ensuring all information remains up to date in welcome books, OTA fields and descriptions, instructions on use of amenities, parking and home access, etc. 



CLEANING OPERATIONS

Focus: Managing turnover schedules, vendor oversight, inventory restocking, and ensuring consistent cleaning quality across all properties.



• Cleaning Scheduling & Coordination

Managing cleaning schedules, monitoring upcoming turnovers, handling last-minute changes, and communicating with cleaning vendors.



• Cleaning Vendor Sourcing & Vetting

Researching, vetting, and recommending new cleaning partners in existing or new markets.



• Turnover Checklists

Creating, maintaining, and refining detailed turnover checklist SOPs for each property.



• Cleaning Quality Control 



• Inventory Restocking (Consumables)



SALES

Any experience with CRMs (namely Hubspot), sales funnels, managing sales pipelines, etc. 



TECHNOLOGY

Any experience with ClickUp, 
, Notion, product management, or engineering / technical background.



**Must have excellent English language proficiency (verbal, reading, writing)



Please answer the following questions (submissions without answers will not be considered):  



1. Describe your experience in hospitality management / short term rentals - what positions have you worked in? What tools and technologies do you have experience with?



2. What do you consider to be your biggest professional achievement?



3. Convince us you are a self-starter. That is, you take initiative to solve problems even when given limited information.



4. What is your current availability and number of hours per week desired? Please list in the following bulleted format if available only specific days of the week / hours: (Example) - Monday - 16:30 - 01:30 (EST) - Tuesday - 08:30 - 17:30 (EST). 

*If open to any schedule, reply "Open to needs of organization."



5. What would make you want to stay at a company forever?



Thank you,



Brian Foster, CEO

Travel Luxe Vacation Rentals



PS: Serious Applicants Only - looking to fill this role within 7 days!

title: Real Estate Cold Caller - US Wholesaling Operation ($3.5/hr + Performance Bonuses)

We're a US-based real estate wholesaling company, closing ~20 single-family deals per year in Alabama. We're expanding our cold calling operation and looking for ONE experienced full-time cold caller to join our team long-term. The right person will grow with us as we scale.



This is a long-term position, not a short gig. We pay on time, every time, and we reward performance.

- Set warm appointments for our acquisitions team

- Follow up consistently with warm leads

- Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps), quiet workspace, USB headset

- Available 8 hours/day, overlapping with US business hours (CST)



Pay Structure



- Base: $3.5/hr (negotiable based on experience and recorded call samples)

).

What We're NOT Looking For



- Agencies or teams (we want to hire ONE person directly)

title: Executive Assistant (Remote)
description:
We are seeking an exceptional Executive Assistant to support a founder-led U.S.-based technology company.



This role goes beyond traditional administrative work. The successful candidate will work closely with company leadership to help coordinate business operations, recruiting, customer communications, documentation, and special projects.



The ideal candidate is highly intelligent, organized, resourceful, and able to learn quickly. You should be comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and solving problems with minimal supervision.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants exposure to business operations and executive-level decision-making within a growing technology company.



** Responsibilities **

Executive & Administrative Support

- Manage calendars, meetings, and scheduling for leadership

- Track action items and ensure timely follow-up on important tasks

- Conduct online research and gather information for business initiatives



Recruiting Coordination

- Post job openings and manage applicant communications

- Review resumes and identify qualified candidates

- Schedule interviews and coordinate recruitment activities



Customer & Business Support

- Respond to customer inquiries via
 and chat

- Coordinate communication between customers and internal teams

- Help ensure customers receive timely and professional responses



Marketing & Business Operations

- Assist with webinar, event, and trade show coordination

- Arrange travel, hotel accommodations, and logistics for company events

- Support various operational and strategic projects as assigned



** Qualifications **

Required

- Exceptional written and spoken English with near-native fluency

- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities

- Outstanding organizational and time-management skills

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

- Excellent attention to detail and follow-through

- Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and online collaboration tools

- Ability to learn new software platforms and business processes quickly

- Reliable high-speed internet connection and professional home office environment



Preferred

- Bachelor's degree with strong academic performance

- Experience supporting executives, founders, or senior leadership

- Experience working with U.S.-based companies

- Experience in administration, operations, recruiting, customer success, or project coordination

- Familiarity with SaaS, ERP, AI, technology, or startup environments



** Work Schedule **

Full-time remote position

- Must work during U.S. Pacific Time business hours

- Must be available and responsive on Microsoft Teams during working hours

- Must be able to join virtual meetings on short notice when business needs arise

- Ability to occasionally adjust schedule to support important business activities



** What We Look For **

We are seeking someone who is:

- Extremely reliable and responsive

- Intellectually curious and eager to learn

- Comfortable handling confidential information

- Professional when communicating with customers, candidates, and business partners

- Able to solve problems independently rather than waiting for instructions

- Motivated to grow with a fast-growing technology company



** Application Instructions **

To be considered, please submit:

- Your resume.

- A brief introduction (200–400 words) describing your background and career goals.

- A response to the following question:

   "Tell us about something meaningful you accomplished without being asked to do it. What was the situation, what actions did you take, and what was the result?"

- To confirm you have carefully read this job description, please include the word "Catalyst" in the subject line.



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.

title: REMOTE GRAPHIC DESIGNER FOR UK COMPANY
description:
OVERVIEW 

- Position: Graphic Designer

- Location: Remote

- Contract: Full Time

- Working Hours: 35 hours per week

- Schedule: 7 hours per day, 5 days per week

- Working Days: Flexible, to be agreed in advance

- Monthly Salary: $300–$400 USD + bonuses





ABOUT THE ROLE

We are currently seeking a full-time Graphic Designer to join our company and help bring our brand and products to life through high-quality visual content. 



We are a London-based e-commerce business selling products on Amazon, eBay, and our own website. This is a fully remote position, and you’ll be working closely with our team to design product listing images, Amazon A+ Content, product packaging, social media graphics, and other visual materials that help drive sales and build a strong brand identity.



We're looking for someone creative, reliable, and detail-oriented—someone who can take ideas and turn them into clean, effective, and eye-catching designs. If you’re someone who loves designing, enjoys having creative freedom, and wants to be part of a fast-moving company where your work will have a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.





RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design high-converting product listing images for Amazon, eBay, website, etc.

- Create A+ Content and brand story sections for Amazon listings

- Design eye-catching and on-brand product packaging

- Test and optimise different main image variations to improve click-through rates

- Enhance product photos by adjusting lighting, colour, sharpness, and overall composition

- Remove backgrounds and add visual effects to make products stand out

- Ensure all images meet the technical and visual standards of each e-commerce platform

- Collaborate with the team to maintain a consistent brand look across all visuals



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 2 years of proven experience in graphic design, ideally in e-commerce

- Experience using AI image generation tools

- Proficiency in design software, such as Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.

- Strong portfolio showcasing product image design, packaging, and branding work

- Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal)

- Reliable internet connection and a functional remote workspace

- Well-organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks at once

- Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and looking for a long-term role

- Available to work 5 days per week



WHY JOIN US

- 2 weeks of paid vacation per year

- Monthly & year-end bonuses based on performance

- Potential to increase hours and salary over time based on performance

- Opportunity for long-term growth and promotion within the company

- 100% remote – work from anywhere, as long as you're focused during your agreed working hours



HOW TO APPLY

If you’re interested in this role and meet the requirements listed above, please apply by filling out the application form at the link below. We’re looking forward to hearing from you!







NOTE 1: Only applications submitted through the form will be considered.



NOTE 2: Please make sure your portfolio includes examples of product images, e-commerce graphics, Amazon listing images, packaging design, or similar work.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Pex Life Records LLC: Our Vision for Transformative Music



Pex Life Records is an independent label where urban music meets personal development. Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Our music is purpose-driven, focusing on critical life areas: health, financial literacy, peak performance, and spirituality.



You will be joining a brand with a strong, engaged audience of over 1,000
 subscribers and 20,
 followers. Your work will directly contribute to inspiring and uplifting thousands through music.-----The Role: Drive Revenue, Build a Team, Shape a Brand



We are seeking a highly motivated Music Manager to lead our sales, operations, and team development. This is a pivotal role for a professional ready to commit to a 45-50 hour/week position that offers substantial commission potential and a clear path to high earnings.



Key Areas of Impact:

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Team Leadership: Recruit, hire, train, and inspire contractors and staff to ensure stellar performance and successful new releases.

Operations & Finance: Manage contracts, maintain essential financial records (bookkeeping), and ensure compliance and seamless communication across all stakeholders.

Customer Experience: Be the face of the company, creating memorable customer experiences, explaining product/service prices, and handling key inquiries.



Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential



This is a performance-driven role with a clear path to significant monthly income through our incentive program.

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

Monthly Compensation Range: $505–$900 Guaranteed Base + Generous Commission.



Compensation Structure by Target Revenue Goal:

Achieve $1,200 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $675 Minimum. Commission Rate: 10% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement.

Achieve $2,400 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $900 Minimum. Commission Rate: 15% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: Social Security System & Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing.



Flexibility and Structure:



100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!



Application Instructions:



Demonstrate your expertise in sales management (client acquisition, appointment setting, and closing calls) in your proposal. To ensure you've read these details, please begin your proposal with the phrase "purple elephant."

title: DevOps & Systems Tech Wizard Wanted
description:
// who we're looking for

We are looking for a tech wizard — a genuine enthusiast, a self-described nerd, a person who tinkers because they can't help themselves. Someone who has opinions about encryption protocols at midnight and has probably already broken and rebuilt their own home server stack for fun.



This is a long-term relationship, and we're treating it like one. We are starting small — a handful of hours per week — while we mutually vet and validate fit. We'll be testing your knowledge, your thinking, your instincts. If you're the real deal, the hours grow, the trust grows, and so does the opportunity.



If you have the credentials, the curiosity, and the character — we're not just hiring you. We're building with you. Equity conversations are on the table for the right long-term partner.

We are building an advanced, multi-layer technical infrastructure. We need someone who can grow into it, ideally from the ground floor. You don't need to check every box. But you need to be deeply, personally invested in technology — and we need to be able to see that in how you write, what you know, and where you spend your time online.



// core technical requirements

Server & Infrastructure



VPS server stack setup, management, and maintenance

Back-end network infrastructure design and administration

Linux proficiency — command line fluency is non-negotiable

VOIP system configuration and network integration

Webhooks, CI/CD concepts, automated deployment pipelines

N8N workflow automation (preferred over simpler drag-and-drop tools)

Web Development



Full-stack or strong back-end web development capabilities

API integration — building, connecting, and maintaining third-party APIs

Database management: design, optimization, and security

WordPress and web design experience a plus

Security & Privacy



Linux penetration testing fundamentals

Encryption and privacy protocol literacy

Cipher knowledge, VPN configuration and management

Familiarity with Tails OS, Tor, Qubes OS

Crypto and digital asset basic operations

// tooling & workflow proficiency

You will be working inside a modern, tool-rich environment. Comfort navigating and connecting these systems is essential:



ClickUp Google Workspace Obsidian N8N GitHub / Git Webhooks REST APIs Linux CLI VPS Providers VOIP Systems

LLM & AI Integration — this is a serious requirement, not an afterthought:



Must have genuine, working knowledge of multiple leading LLM platforms

Understand prompt engineering at a functional level — tokens, context windows, model selection for specific use cases

Know the differences between models and when to deploy which for what purpose

Capable of doing all work manually and independently — AI tools enhance your output, they do not replace your skill

We will provide full subscription access to multiple leading AI platforms for use in our projects. You bring the expertise; we supply the tools.



Blockchain Familiarity (preferred, not required):



You don't need to be a blockchain developer, but a working familiarity with blockchain fundamentals is a meaningful plus. If it's already in your world — even casually — flag it.



// programming languages

We expect proficiency in at least several programming languages relevant to systems, back-end, and automation work. In your application, please tell us specifically:



Which languages you are proficient in

How comfortable you are in each — be honest, be specific

What you have actually built or maintained with them

We're not running a quiz — we're looking for self-awareness and depth. Someone who knows three languages deeply interests us more than someone who lists twelve and masters none.



// compensation & hours

Starting rate: $6/hr, sliding scale based on demonstrated skill and validated expertise. We know what someone with this full stack of capabilities commands on the market — we're not pretending otherwise. We are specifically looking for someone who sees the value in getting in early, growing with us, and earning more as we do.



Initial engagement: 2–4 hours/day, 5 days/week, as we establish the working relationship. Growth toward full-time (8 hrs/day) is the goal, and we have real client work that can fill those hours.



If you are a seasoned senior-level engineer who sees this and thinks the rate is beneath you — we still want to hear from you. We are maintaining a talent file. As our infrastructure scales, higher-tier paid engagements will follow, and we'd rather already know who we want to call.



Additionally, this position can be paired with our general Virtual Assistant opening (posted separately). If you have the technical chops for this role, the admin side is well within reach. That position pays at its own rate for qualifying admin tasks, giving you a potential path to a fuller day's work from day one.



// how to apply — read this carefully

We are not interested in AI-generated cover letters that mirror our job posting back at us with different formatting. We can spot it. It will disqualify you immediately.



What we want to see in your application:



Your actual background — where your technical experience came from, how you developed it, what you've built

What you are personally into — the technologies you explore on your own time, the rabbit holes you go down for fun

The communities you're part of — forums, 
 servers, GitHub communities, subreddits, open-source projects, anything that shows you live in this world

The specific tools and programs you use — be precise, not vague

A demonstration that you are a genuine enthusiast — not someone who learned these things for a job, but someone for whom this is a way of life

English proficiency is preferred for this role, as a portion of the work involves live collaboration with tea
mbers on calls. That said, if you are a legitimate technical savant who speaks passable English and can communicate clearly in writing, we will prioritize your technical depth over polish.



Additional requirements: Strong typing speed, fast reading comprehension, quick analytical thinking, and the ability to context-switch across complex tasks without losing the thread.



We are looking for a diamond in the rough. If you don't meet every requirement but you are deeply invested in this world, you learn fast, and you can prove it — apply anyway and make your case.

title: Real Estate Cold Caller- Land and House Wholesaling
description:
We are a real estate investment company that buys vacant land, lots, and residential properties directly from owners across the United States. We operate virtually and nationally. We are growing and looking for a driven, professional cold caller to join our team full time.



ABOUT THE ROLE



Your primary job is making outbound calls to property owners across the United States to identify motivated sellers who may be interested in a cash offer for their property. This is not a high pressure sales role. It is a relationship and qualification role. Your job is to have warm, genuine conversations, understand the seller's situation, gather property information, and identify whether there is a fit for our buying criteria.



Full scripts, training, and all tools are provided. Real estate experience is a strong plus but we will train the right person.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Make high volume outbound calls to property owners using our power dialer.

Conduct warm, professional conversations based on provided scripts.

Send immediate SMS follow up texts to contacts who did not answer or requested a callback.

Qualify sellers by asking the right questions about their property and motivation.

Log all call and text notes and activity in our CRM after every interaction.

Identify and flag hot leads for immediate follow up by the acquisitions team.

Manage follow up sequences combining calls and texts until a lead responds or is disqualified.

Participate in brief weekly check-ins with the team.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required:

Clear, confident, and warm phone voice.

Reliable high speed internet connection.

Quiet professional calling environment.

Available Monday through Friday during US Eastern business hours.

Strong written English for CRM note taking.

Honest, dependable, and detail oriented.

Takes initiative and does not wait to be told what to do.

Flexible and adapts quickly when conversations take unexpected turns.

Thinks on their feet and stays composed under pressure.

Every seller is different and you need to meet them where they are.



Strongly Preferred:

Experience cold calling for US real estate investors or wholesalers.

Familiarity with motivated seller outreach and land or house deals.

Experience with CRM tools such as GoHighLevel, FreedomSoft, REsimpli, or similar. GoHighLevel experience is a strong plus as it is the platform we work in.

English speakers are strongly encouraged to apply. Bilingual English and Spanish is an additional advantage but is not required.



COMPENSATION AND HOURS



$5 per hour

Full time — 40 hours per week.

Opportunity to increase pay based on performance and results.

Long term role with growth potential as the company scales.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



This is a results-oriented role in a supportive environment. We invest in our team and want you to succeed. We also move fast and expect our callers to do the same.



An experienced caller using our power dialer is expected to:



Complete 300 to 500 dials per day.

Have 50 to 100 live conversations per day.

Send SMS follow ups to all unanswered contacts same day.

Identify and log 3 to 8 qualified leads per day.

Flag at least 1 HOT lead per day for immediate team follow up.



If you have experience with power dialers and motivated seller calling you will recognize these as very achievable numbers. If high volume calling combined with a warm professional approach sounds like your strength, this role is built for you. If you prefer a slower pace this is not the right fit and that is completely okay.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered please do both of the following. Applications missing either of these will not be reviewed.



1. Submit your resume or work history with relevant experience highlighted.



2. Answer these questions in writing:

   a. Describe a specific cold calling campaign you have worked on. What were you calling about, what was your approach, and what results did you get?

   b. Have you ever called motivated sellers for a real estate investor or wholesaling company? If yes, please describe the experience.

   c. Tell us about a time you had to think quickly and adapt during a difficult conversation. What happened and how did you handle it?



We are not looking for someone to read a script robotically. We are looking for someone who is genuinely warm, professional, takes initiative, and takes pride in every conversation. Our sellers are real people going through real situations and we treat them with care and respect. If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

title: Certified Medical Coder / Coding Auditor — Orthopedic & Spine Physician Claims
description:
We are looking for an experienced U.S. medical coder / coding auditor with strong experience in orthopedic, spine, and musculoskeletal physician coding.



Our company, MedCode Pro, helps physicians and procedural clinics identify CPT codes, modifiers, add-on codes, and documentation requirements that may have been missed during billing.



We are starting with short audit projects where we review approximately 60 days of clinic claims and compare the billed codes against the supporting clinical notes. The initial focus will be orthopedic and spine-related physician services, including clinic visits, procedures, injections, and operative notes.



This role is ideal for someone who can read provider documentation and determine what codes are supported, what may have been missed, and what documentation is needed to support the recommendation.



Responsibilities

- Review de-identified orthopedic and spine-related clinical notes, procedure notes, operative reports, and claim/superbill data



- Compare documented services against codes that were actually billed



- Identify potential missed CPT codes, add-on codes, modifiers, HCPCS codes, and ICD-10-CM opportunities

- Review E/M coding where relevant, including documentation support and modifier use

- Flag documentation gaps where a code may be possible but not fully supported

- Identify potential undercoding, overcoding, bundling, unbundling, or compliance risks

- Provide a clear coding rationale for each recommendation

- Summarize findings in a structured audit format



Specialty Focus

We are especially interested in experience with:

- Orthopedic surgery

- Spine surgery

-Musculoskeletal procedures

- Pain-related spine procedures

- Injections and procedure coding

- Imaging-guided procedures, if applicable

- E/M coding for orthopedic clinics

- Modifiers commonly used in physician billing

- Add-on codes and bundled procedure logic



Required Qualifications

Experience with U.S. physician/professional fee coding



Experience coding or auditing orthopedic, spine, or musculoskeletal claims



Strong understanding of CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS, and modifiers



Ability to read clinical documentation and determine what codes are supported



Experience reviewing clinic notes, procedure notes, operative reports, claims, or superbills



Strong written English



Detail-oriented and able to explain coding rationale clearly



Comfortable working with spreadsheets or structured audit templates



Preferred Qualifications

CPC, CCS-P, CPMA, or similar certification



Orthopedic coding experience or specialty certification



Experience as a medical coding auditor, ProFee coder, physician coding auditor, or revenue integrity coding specialist



Experience identifying missed CPT codes, add-on codes, modifiers, or undercoding



Experience with NCCI edits, bundling rules, payer rules, denials, or documentation improvement



Familiarity with orthopedic/spine coding areas such as:

Arthroscopy

Fracture care

Joint procedures

Spine decompression/fusion procedures

Epidural steroid injections

Facet injections / medial branch blocks

Radiofrequency ablation

Trigger point / joint injections

Durable medical equipment, braces, or orthotics, if applicable



Important

We are not looking for someone who only has experience with basic billing, charge entry, payment posting, or AR follow-up.



We need someone who can independently review documentation and answer:

“Based on this orthopedic or spine note, what could have been coded, what was missed, and what documentation supports the recommendation?”

description:
AJG Transport (GH Logistics affiliate) is a growing asset based trucking operation focused on keeping freight moving efficiently, profitably, and with structure. Our dispatch operation is built around proactive planning, strong broker relationships, real time communication, and disciplined execution. We believe successful operations come from staying ahead instead of reacting last minute, keeping trucks planned strategically, and maintaining consistency across every load.



Role Overview

You will be responsible for planning and booking freight for AJG Transport while ensuring trucks remain productive, profitable, and moving efficiently. This role requires someone who can think strategically, negotiate confidently, and proactively plan freight instead of simply reacting to available loads, while playing a critical role in improving operational efficiency, reducing downtime, and helping scale the fleet through stronger planning and broker relationships.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Book profitable freight for AJG Transport with a focus on planned, high quality loads

• Negotiate freight rates directly with brokers while building long term business relationships

• Plan and dispatch loads strategically to maximize loaded miles and reduce deadhead

• Coordinate closely with drivers to ensure smooth pickups, deliveries, and communication

• Monitor market trends and identify opportunities for dedicated lanes and consistent freight

• Utilize load boards and dispatch platforms to source freight and manage dispatch operations

• Maintain organized tracking, updates, and communication throughout the dispatch process

• Solve live operational challenges quickly while maintaining professionalism and urgency

• Work proactively to prevent service failures, downtime, and unnecessary empty miles



What Success Looks Like

• Trucks remain consistently planned with minimal downtime or unnecessary deadhead

• Freight rates are negotiated competitively and profitably

• Strong broker relationships lead to repeat business and consistent lanes=

• Loads are planned proactively rather than reactively

• Dispatch operations remain organized, efficient, and scalable



Who We’re Looking For

• 1+ year of load planning or load booking experience within the US trucking industry

• Strong experience negotiating freight rates with brokers

• Familiarity with DAT, Truckstop, and other load boards

• Experience dispatching dry van, reefer, or flatbed freight is a plus

• Understands freight markets, lane strategy, and operational efficiency

• Strong communication, negotiation, and organizational skills

• Able to multitask in a fast paced live operations environment

• Professional, proactive, and solutions oriented under pressure

• Has broker relationships or experience developing long term broker partnerships



Schedule & Work Setup

• Must work US business hours

• Collaborative Zoom-based work environment (camera open during shift)

Why Join GH Logistics?

• Structured systems and clear expectations

• Hands on leadership and direct feedback

• Defined KPIs and measurable growth

• Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage

• Performance based advancement



What You'll Get

• Consistent pay biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

title: Get Sh!t Done Ninja - Design Workhorse & AI-Powered Visual Operative
description:
This is not a role for someone who wants to clock in, clock out, and collect a check.



This is for the hungry ones.

The ones who stay up late working on passion projects.

The ones who see a bad design and physically cringe.

The ones who believe they were built for more — and are ready to prove it.



You do not need years of experience.

You need fire.



You are the type of person who learns by doing.

You move fast. You figure things out. You do not wait to be told what to do next.



You want to be part of something real — a creative team that moves fast, builds cool things, and actually cares about the work.



This is your shot.









Let's Be Honest



You will not start at the top. Nobody does.



But here is the difference — this is not a dead-end gig. This is a launchpad.



Show up with consistency, creative hunger, and ownership of your work, and your income will grow fast. Not in years. In months.



You will always know what is expected.

You will always know how to level up.

You will always be able to earn more by becoming more.



You are not doing this alone. You are joining a team of driven people who push each other to be better every single day.









What You Will Be Doing



Creating scroll-stopping visuals that make people pause, feel something, and take action.



Adapting to different design styles and brand voices like a creative chameleon — fast and seamless.



Keeping brand guidelines tight and consistent across everything you touch.



Communicating clearly and keeping the team updated without being chased.



Organizing your files, assets, and projects like a pro — clean, structured, findable.



Turning feedback into better work without ego getting in the way.



Juggling multiple creative tasks and deadlines without dropping the ball.



Using Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, and AI-powered tools to produce at speed and quality.



Leveraging AI prompting workflows and AI-assisted creative production to stay ahead of the curve.



Understanding social media formats, sizing, and what performs — not just what looks pretty.



Taking initiative. Solving problems. Not waiting for permission to be great.









What We Train vs. What You Bring



We will train you on tools, systems, workflows, and brand standards.



We cannot train hunger. We cannot train drive. We cannot train the kind of person who refuses to put out mediocre work.



If you show up every day ready to get better, we will invest in you, coach you, and build your creative career alongside you.









What We Expect



Obsessive attention to detail in every pixel you push.



Smart questions when a brief is unclear — not guesswork.



Speed in learning new tools, especially AI-powered creative workflows.



Clean, complete, visually compelling output — every time.









Communication (Non-Negotiable)



Your English must be clear, confident, and professional.



You will be on video regularly with teammates, clients, and the CEO. You must be comfortable showing your face and speaking on camera. This is a team that communicates openly — no hiding behind a screen.









This Is For You If:



You are early in your creative career and ready to accelerate — not wait.



You take pride in making things look incredible, down to the last detail.



You are organized, dependable, and you do what you say you will do.



You want to be part of a team that actually builds together — not just assigns tasks.



You have a great attitude, you are easy to work with, and collaboration comes naturally to you.



You are excited by AI, new tools, and the future of design — not threatened by it.



You believe: "Give me the opportunity and I will outwork everyone to earn my place."









This Is NOT For You If:



You are looking for a comfortable, low-effort hourly gig.



You submit work that is "good enough" instead of great.



You wait to be told what to do instead of figuring it out.



You resist feedback or take creative direction personally.



You see this as just another job instead of a career-building opportunity.









What You Get



Real creative direction and hands-on training — not YouTube tutorials and "figure it out."



Diverse design projects across brands, platforms, and formats.



Experience with AI-assisted creative production that puts you years ahead of other designers.



A team that genuinely supports your growth and celebrates your wins.



A clear path to increase your income based on what you produce — not how long you sit at a desk.



A culture that feels like a mission, not a job.









The Opportunity



Most people wait for the "right time" to bet on themselves.



The ones who win? They start now. They build. They figure it out along the way.



AI has changed the game. A driven creative with the right tools and the right team can produce at a level that used to take agencies years to reach.



If you are committed, focused, and willing to grow fast — you will become incredibly valuable in a very short time.



You are not just filling a role. You are building your creative future with a team that is going somewhere.









How to Apply (READ THIS — It Matters)



Record a 2–3 minute video answering ALL 9 questions below.



Your video is your first impression. We are looking for:



Clear, confident English — especially when talking about your creative thinking.

Attention to detail (if you skip questions, we will notice).



Genuine excitement about this opportunity.



 your application to:

title: Tier 2/3 IT Support & Security Systems Engineer (Remote — US MSP, Night Shift)
description:
Sentry is a US-based managed service provider (MSP) and physical security integrator serving small and mid-sized businesses across the New York metro area. On the IT side, we manage our clients' networks, Microsoft 365 environments, endpoints, and phone systems. On the security side, we design, install, and support their video surveillance and access control systems.



We do things differently from most MSPs: we don't run a Tier 1 help desk. When a client calls or
s, they reach a skilled engineer who takes ownership and gets to work on it immediately, not a scripted first-tier queue or an automated phone tree. That first-contact competence is a significant part of why our clients enjoy working with us, and it's why we only hire technicians at Tier 2 and above.



At the same time, you'll always have support. You'll work directly with senior engineers and the owner, and we take on the most difficult problems as a team. The role is fully remote, but you'll be a full member of ours, not an isolated, outsourced contractor. We stay in close contact and share knowledge openly.



We're looking for a Tier 2/Tier 3 engineer to be a direct, front-line point of contact for our clients across both their IT and physical security needs, fielding requests by phone,
, and ticket, and owning each issue from first contact through resolution. This is a full-time, long-term remote role working US Eastern business hours.



What you'll do



- Serve as the first point of contact for client issues by phone,
, and ticket, and own them from first contact through resolution

- Deliver a confident, professional experience on every interaction; clients should feel they're in good hands from the first minute

- Administer Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (Azure AD): user and license provisioning, Exchange Online, mail flow, and
 security

- Monitor and respond to RMM alerts (Atera) and manage endpoint security tools (Huntress, Bitdefender)

- Troubleshoot networks: firewalls (FortiGate), switches and access points (UniFi), VLANs, VPNs, and DNS

- Administer Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy

- Manage and verify backups (Datto)

- Support VoIP systems and IP phones

- Configure, support, and troubleshoot video surveillance systems (IP cameras, NVRs, and video management software such as Hikvision, Digital Watchdog, and Speco), including secure remote access and viewing

- Administer access control systems (users, credentials, and door schedules) and troubleshoot controllers and readers

- Remotely support our field technicians during security-system installs and service calls

- Collaborate with the team and bring in senior engineers when a problem calls for it

- Keep clear, accurate documentation for every client environment

- Work alongside our AI tooling, which we use heavily across daily operations



What we're looking for



- 3+ years of hands-on IT support experience, ideally at an MSP

- Excellent spoken and written English, with a strong customer-first attitude; you'll be the voice of our company on every call

- The confidence to own client interactions directly, along with the judgment to know when to involve the team on more complex problems

- Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365/Entra, Windows Server, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals

- Hands-on experience with firewalls and managed switches (FortiGate and UniFi a strong plus)

- Experience with IP video surveillance and/or access control systems, or the aptitude and willingness to develop this expertise quickly (it's a core part of what we do)

- Reliable high-speed internet, a backup connection, and a UPS/power backup

- A quiet, dedicated home workspace

title: Customer Success Manager - Marketing
description:
# Customer Success Manager



This is not an easy roll. We are looking for an experienced leader.



Oakwood Marketing is looking for a Customer Success Manager to help manage client communication, onboarding, project progress, and client fulfillment.



We work with contractors and home service businesses. Our clients are busy, so we need someone who can communicate clearly, take control of problems, and keep things moving.



This role is not for someone who needs to be babysat. We are looking for someone confident, reliable, hardworking, organized, and efficient.



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for a leader.



Someone who:



* Takes ownership

* Works fast and efficiently

* Communicates clearly

* Can take control when problems come up

* Does not make excuses

* Pays attention to details

* Follows systems but can also think for themselves

* Is confident speaking with clients

* Can manage multiple clients and tasks at once

* Handles pressure well

* Cares about getting results

* Wants to improve every week



We want someone who sees a problem and starts figuring it out. Not someone who waits around for every little instruction.



## Main Responsibilities



You will help manage clients and keep projects moving from start to finish.



This may include:



* Communicating with clients through
, text, calls, or video meetings

* Helping clients through onboarding

* Following up when information is missing

* Helping solve access issues with domains, CRM, Google Business Profile, or other tools

* Managing website project tasks and updates

* Helping with basic SEO and Google Business Profile work

* Helping with ads support when needed

* Helping set up and test CRM forms, automations, and lead systems

* Preparing simple client updates and reports

* Updating task boards and client records

* Making sure tasks are completed correctly and on time

* Flagging problems early before they become bigger issues

* Helping improve internal systems and processes



You do not need to be an expert in every area. You do need to be resourceful, willing to learn, and able to follow systems.



## Requirements



You should be:



* Reliable

* Organized

* Confident

* Hardworking

* Detail-oriented

* Good with written English

* Comfortable speaking with clients

* Comfortable using online tools and software

* Able to work independently

* Able to learn new systems quickly

* Able to handle feedback

* Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT



We can teach the systems. We cannot teach ownership, work ethic, or common sense.



## Preferred Experience



Experience with any of these is a plus:



* Website builders

* GoHighLevel / LeadConnector

* Google Business Profile

* Local SEO

* Google Ads

* Canva

* Google Drive

* Task management tools

* Marketing agency work

* Home service or contractor businesses

* Client communication



## Work Schedule



This is a remote position.



You must be available for client communication until at least **1 PM Central USA Time every weekday** when client communication is needed.



This means if a client needs help, has questions, needs an onboarding call, or there is an issue that needs to be handled, you need to be reachable and able to respond during that window.



Outside of client communication, most work can be completed on your own schedule as long as tasks are completed correctly and deadlines are met.



The main expectation is simple: clients should not be left waiting, and projects should not get stuck because communication was delayed.



## Client Call Expectations



Some client calls may be required.



For client calls, you must have:



* Strong internet

* Quiet background

* Professional appearance

* Business casual clothing

* No background noise

* Clear communication

* Confidence leading the call



You may need to help clients with onboarding, access issues, project questions, or simple training.



## What Success Looks Like



You are doing a great job if:



* Clients move through onboarding faster

* Projects do not get stuck

* Clients receive clear updates

* Problems are handled quickly

* Tasks are completed correctly

* Client information is organized

* The owner does not need to constantly check on you

* You help make the business more systemized and scalable



## Not a Fit



This role is not a fit if you:



* Need constant reminders

* Move slowly

* Avoid responsibility

* Make excuses

* Miss details

* Cannot communicate with clients professionally

* Wait for someone else to solve every problem

* Get overwhelmed by basic software

* Cannot handle feedback

* Do not care about client results



## Job Post Version



**Job Title:** Customer Success Manager

**Type:** Remote

**Company:** Oakwood Marketing



Oakwood Marketing is looking for a Customer Success Manager to help manage client communication, onboarding, project progress, and client fulfillment for contractors and home service businesses.

You will help with client communication, onboarding, website project tasks, SEO, Google Business Profile work, ads support, CRM setup, reporting, and internal operations.



You do not need to be an expert in everything. You do need to be resourceful, willing to learn, and able to follow systems.

* Comfortable talking with clients

* Comfortable with online tools and software

* Able to work independently

Remote position. Must be available for client communication until at least **1 PM Central Time every weekday** when needed. Outside of client communication, work can be completed on your own schedule as long as deadlines are met.

title: Growth Lead — Acquisition (B2B / Manufacturing) - Content + Strategy Driven B2B Growth
description:
Read this first:



This post is for one specific person: a content-first growth marketer with genuine marketing intelligence, real B2B experience, and a serious work ethic. We are hiring one person. If that sounds like you, keep reading. 



Who we are:



Feight AI builds custom AI solutions for manufacturing companies in Central Europe doing over €1M in annual revenue. We design and build automation specifically for how each client actually runs their operations.



Our vision is simple. We want to be one of the top names companies in our region think of when they need serious AI work done for their business.



Where we are right now: the technical side is solid, the founder closes deals one to one, and the product works. What's missing is marketing. It's at zero. No content, no funnel, no paid presence.



That's the job. A blank canvas. The person we hire gets to define what good marketing at Feight AI looks like from scratch.



We're looking for the person who runs our entire acquisition function on the ground. What we need now is someone to take over content, channels and paid ads. Not as an assistant. As the person who owns this side of the business day to day.



What matters most:



Two things will d
 whether this works.



The first is content creation. Our organic growth on Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and the blog depends on it, and our paid ads only work if the creative is strong. So we need a real creator. Someone who writes, edits, scripts, and ships content consistently and well.



The second is marketing intelligence. By that we mean the ability to look at the data and figure out what's actually going on. If a campaign is dying, you should be able to tell whether it's an audience problem, a message problem, an offer problem, or a channel problem, and what to try next. We give you the direction. You make it real on the ground and adjust as you go.



If both of these aren't your strong suit, this won't work.



What you'll be doing



Day to day you'll handle:



Posting and managing content across Meta (FB + IG), LinkedIn, YouTube and our blog.

Building funnels: landing pages, lead magnets,
 sequences.

Running paid ads (Meta/LinekdIn/Google): creative, audiences, budgets, testing, scaling.

Using AI tools to move faster than people who do this work manually.



You don't have to be a world expert at every one of these. Competent and resourceful is fine.



What we are not asking for:



No cold outreach. No warm outreach. We are not interested in that channel at the 
nt. The focus is content, funnels and ads.



Who we are hiring:



We are looking for someone who:



Creates content as their main skill. Not someone who "also writes" or manages other writers. You make the stuff yourself.

Can look at a week of data and tell us in five minutes what's working, what isn't, and what they'd change.

Is organized. You know your numbers, you report on a regular rhythm without being chased, and you come to us with proposals, not just observations.

Has actually driven B2B pipeline for international clients before. Real numbers, real results. Not just "campaigns you were part of."

Has B2B acquisition experience specifically. Not general agency work, not e-commerce, not social media management.

Has a strong work ethic. If you say you'll ship something, it ships. On time. At the quality you promised.

Actually likes this work. Hooks, funnels, ads, content. This is the kind of work you like to do.

Wants to earn more through results, not through hours. The base is steady. The bonus is where it gets interesting.

Communicates well, professionally, without us having to chase replies.

Doesn't need micromanaging. We give direction and context. You give back a working engine.

Can start moving fast. You don't need three months to figure out the basics.



This probably isn't for you if:



Content creation isn't your strongest skill.

You can execute a plan but you can't tell why something isn't working when the numbers go sideways.

You've never personally owned B2B acquisition outcomes.

You need long onboarding to figure out the basics.

Your background is general agency, e-commerce or social media management.

You're mainly motivated by hourly pay, not by performance.



What we offer



$1,500/month base, paid reliably and on time.

A performance bonus tied to qualified leads and closed revenue. If your work drives sales, the bonus has no upper limit. This role exists for someone who wants the upside.

Room to grow. As Feight scales, this seat scales with it. If things go well, today's Growth Lead becomes tomorrow's Head of Growth with a team underneath.

Fair, direct treatment. Clear expectations, no politics, predictable payments. We treat people running important parts of our business like partners.

Remote work with autonomy. Work on your own rhythm as long as the work ships and the numbers move.



To apply:



Start your message with the word PLAYBOOK on the first line, so we know you read the post. Anything without it gets skipped.



Then send us:



A short video, 1 to 2 minutes, where you introduce yourself. Who you are, what you've done, and why this role caught your attention.

Three samples of content you've personally created. At least one of them should be video.

Two or three B2B results you've personally driven. Numbers, links, before and after. The harder the proof, the better.

Your full AI stack for marketing work. What tools you actually use for content, funnels, design, copy, ads, research, anything else. We want to see the whole setup, not just one tool.



Generic copy-paste applications get skipped. We would rather wait than fill the seat with the wrong person.



Next steps:



Here's what happens after you send your application:



We'll get back to you within 5 business days.

If your application makes it through the first filter, we'll send you a short trial task. It should take less than an hour.

The top candidates from that round move on to an interview with the founder.



All the best,



FEIGHT AI Team.

title: Video Editor Capable of Animations and Motion FX
description:
Full-Time Video Editor With Animation & Motion FX Skills



_________________________________________________________________________



We are looking for a talented, reliable, and detail-oriented video editor who can create high-quality edits with strong animation and motion graphics skills.



This role is for someone who takes their work seriously, communicates quickly, meets deadlines, and wants to build a long-term working relationship with a growing team.



We manage clients in niches like stock options trading, ecommerce, fitness, and other semi-complex topics, so we need someone who is not only good at editing, but also willing to learn new topics quickly and understand the content they are editing.



This is not a role for someone who only wants easy edits or does the bare minimum. We are looking for someone who is hardworking, consistent, reliable, and willing to improve over time.

_________________________________________________________________________



**What You’ll Be Doing:



You will be editing videos for clients who create educational, business, finance, ecommerce, and fitness content.



Your work may include:



Editing long-form YouTube videos



Adding animations, motion graphics, captions, transitions, zooms, visual effects, and b-roll



Improving pacing, flow, retention, and overall viewer experience



Making edits that look professional, clean, and engaging



Understanding the topic of the video so the edit supports what the speaker is saying



Following feedback and revision instructions accurately



Helping us create a consistent editing style for each client



**Requirements:



1. You must have strong video editing skills.



2. You must be capable of adding animations and motion FX.



3. You must have very good English. We do not want to deal with many spelling, grammar, or punctuation mistakes in the edits or captions.



4. You must be able to work at least 6 days per week, ideally 6–7 days per week.



5. Full-time availability is preferred, but you must be able to work at least 4 hours per day minimum.



6. You must respond quickly to messages and be available for consistent communication.



7. You must be able to meet deadlines.



8. You must be organized, reliable, and consistent.



9. You must be willing to learn about new topics quickly.



10. You must be able to follow instructions carefully.



11. You must include your portfolio or examples of past work in your application.



___________________________________________________



**Important English Requirement:



A big part of this role is making sure the final videos have clean captions, correct spelling, proper grammar, and good punctuation.



Many of our clients talk about topics like stock options trading, ecommerce, business, and fitness. These topics can be semi-complex, so you need to be willing to understand what the speaker is talking about instead of editing blindly.



We do not expect you to be an expert in every topic right away, but we do expect you to care enough to learn, research when needed, and avoid careless mistakes.



Reliable communication is very important. We need someone who replies quickly, gives updates, asks questions when needed, and does not disappear during projects.

___________________________________________________



**Who This Role Is NOT For:



This role is not for you if:



You are slow to respond to messages



You often miss deadlines



You do not pay attention to details



You make many English mistakes in captions or edits



You are not willing to learn new topics



You only want simple edits with no feedback or revisions



You disappear during projects



You cannot work consistently at least 6 days per week



You do not have examples of past video editing work



**Who This Role Is For:



This role is for you if:



You are hardworking and reliable



You take pride in your edits



You want long-term work



You communicate quickly and clearly



You can handle feedback professionally



You are willing to improve



You are good at editing, animations, and motion effects



You want to build trust with a team that rewards good work



If you are willing to build a trustworthy relationship with us by showing that you are a hardworking, reliable, and consistent editor, you will be rewarded well in the long term.

___________________________________________________



Benefits of this job:

1. Completely remote work

2. Get to work with big influencers

3. We help build up your experience and portfolio

4. Flexible work hours, you can work whenever you want as long as you get projects done on time

5. A super chill and cool work environment. As long as we stay in constant communication, we like to keep things casual. Chats don't have to be super professional or anything, all we care about is that we're getting results and getting videos done on time.

6. Room to grow with this role. If you perform well in the role and show that you are reliable/consistent with your work you can be promoted/become a more integral part of the team.



**How To Apply:



At the very top line of your application, write:



“I read the entire job post” (required or else we will skip your application)



Then include:



Your portfolio or examples of your past video editing work (required or else we will skip your application)



A short explanation of your experience with video editing, animations, and motion graphics



The editing software you use



Your availability per day and per week



Your internet speed and computer specs, if possible



A short explanation of why you think you would be a good fit for this role



Applications that do not include a portfolio or past work examples will not be considered.



We are looking for someone serious, reliable, and long-term. If that sounds like you, we would love to see your work.

title: Job Title: Virtual Bookkeeper and Data Entry Specialist

OUR COMPANY VALUES:

Respect for All: Diversity is embraced, and every tea
mber is treated with respect, fairness, and empathy. Our inclusive work environment encourages collaboration and fosters mutual respect.



High-Quality Work: We are committed to delivering exceptional work to our clients. We continuously strive for excellence, adapting to meet our clients' evolving needs and exceeding their expectations.



Client-Centric Approach: Our clients' success is our priority. We listen to their needs, understand their goals, and provide tailored solutions to help them achieve financial success and growth.



Continuous Improvement: Embracing a culture of continuous learning and improvement, we encourage innovation and invest in the professional development of our team to stay ahead in the dynamic financial landscape.



Collaborative Teamwork: Our collaborative and supportive team environment encourages open communication and cooperation. Together, we achieve more for our clients and the firm.



Data Security and Confidentiality: Ensuring data security and confidentiality is paramount. We implement stringent protocols to safeguard our clients' sensitive information.



RESPONSIBILITIES:



Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger entries.



Perform regular bank reconciliations to ensure the accuracy of financial transactions.



Process supplier invoices, verify expenses, and prepare payments in a timely manner.



Manage client invoices, follow up on payments, and ensure timely collections.



Generate regular financial reports, such as income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.



Handle payroll tasks, including calculating salaries, taxes, and deductions, and ensuring timely and accurate payments to employees.



Analyze expenses, identify cost-saving opportunities, and provide insights into financial performance.



Ensure compliance with tax regulations, including the preparation of simple US Income Tax Returns for individuals or small businesses.



Utilize accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, Wave Apps) proficiently for bookkeeping tasks.



Maintain high attention to detail for precise financial data entry.



Provide financial insights and support to the accounting team and firm executives for decision-making.



Communicate with clients in a professional tone that both educates and inspires them.



QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:



Strong organizational abilities and time management skills to handle multiple tasks efficiently.



Excellent English verbal and written communication skills for professional client communication and correspondence.



Proficiency in using various communication tools, project management platforms, and office software.



Bookkeeping experience, with a solid understanding of basic accounting principles and practices.



Proficiency in using accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, Wave Apps) and the ability to manage financial records accurately.



Ability to maintain well-organized financial records and easily retrieve information when needed.



Strong analytical skills to generate financial reports and analyze financial data.



Availability to work during US Eastern Standard Time business hours.



Proactive and adaptable attitude to thrive in a dynamic environment.



Trustworthiness and discretion when handling sensitive financial information.



TO APPLY

Please prepare for a thorough interview process, as we are looking for a permanent addition to our team.



Step 1: Reply to this Job post on OnlineJobs.ph with your favorite company value and explain why you would fit our company culture. Please note: We will not respond to any communications outside this app.



Step 2: Based on your answers, you will receive a message either scheduling an interview or encouraging you to keep up your job search.



Step 3: Attend your scheduled interview.



Step 4: Depending on your first interview, you may be asked to join a group informational session. 

To attend this session, you will be required to:

Sign a Non-disclosure Agreement (NDA)

Provided five (5) references, three (3) of the five would need professional or scholastic references.

At the end of this session, you will be given a small task to complete.

If you are passionate about delivering high-quality work, believe in upholding ethical standards, and possess the skills and values we are looking for, we would love to hear from you!
